title.narrative: Scaling Up Electromagnetics surveys for Large-Scale Hydrogeological Imaging of Groundwater in Complex Ethiopian Geological Settings

description.narrative:
To support Integrated Water Resource Management (IWRM) in Ethiopia through scaling up advanced geophysics groundwater data collection for development of hydrogeological maps, and institutionalization of electromagnetic geophysics within the Ethiopian Ministry of Water & Energy (MOWE).
This project directly targets the core priorities outlined in the National IWRM Programme — addressing institutional capacity gaps, data scarcity, and the integration of cutting-edge technologies into national water management practices. Through the implementation of an advanced electromagnetic (EM) survey in critical water-stressed regions of Ethiopia, the project will generate the data and capacity needed to support parallel groundwater management and water supply initiatives across the country. Key outputs will include: 1. A high-resolution aerial coverage transient electromagnetic survey of the target region, providing essential insight into aquifer structure, extent, and recharge potential. 2. Generation of a three-dimensional hydrogeological model of the survey area for input to NIWRM decision-making and sustainable groundwater management practices. 3. Institutionalization of electromagnetic (EM) geophysics expertise within the MoWE and Addis Ababa University (AAU), supporting long-term integration of geophysics in groundwater planning and fostering sustainable academic and technical partnerships between Danish and Ethiopian Universities.

title.narrative: Report detailing collected geophysical data for sharing with stakeholders, as well as completion of all geophysical modelling workflows resulting culminating in a quasi-3D model of the electrical resistivity in the survey region.

target.value: Joint mission planning between MoWE/AU identifying intended survey area and data densities, and initiation of tendering process.
Completion of advanced TEM data collection.
Completion of advanced data processing and finalization of geophysical images. Identification of areas requiring follow-up high-resolution ground-based surveys.

title.narrative: High-resolution hydrogeological model of the surveyed region, informed by dense geophysical data coverage, to support evidence-based groundwater management and long-term water resource planning.
Publication and dissemination of a regional hydrogeological model of the surveyed area, accessible to government agencies and water sector stakeholders.

target.value: A comprehensive, high-resolution hydrogeological model based on advanced geophysics, providing detailed subsurface structures and aquifer insights to better inform groundwater development, protection, and management decisions, and actively applied in support of the NIWRMP.

target.value: Compilation of background geological documents for survey area, including available geological maps, borehole reports, and existing geophysical data.

Implementation of geological model into at least 3 water management initiatives supporting the NIWRMP.
